Messages.Author: Ray Babbitt
Messages.Body:
Malkavian Prank
Master
Each Methuselah holds between 1 and 4 pool in his or her hand. Guess the
amount of pool in each Methuselah's hand. Each time you guess correctly,
you gain that pool. If you guess incorrectly, that Methuselah gains that
much pool from the blood bank.

OK, here's my question: If I play the Prank, do I get a "guess" at how
many pool I have in my own hand? If so, this means I get 4 pool for
free! ("Guess" wrong.) By the way the card reads, I get to guess each
Methuselah, and it doesn't say "all Methuselah but the person playing
the Prank." If so, this seems like an easy 4 pool, and maybe more (if
I'm lucky).

Is there errata to this card, or is this what was originally intended?

Thanks!

Ray Babbitt
RBab...@Novell.COM
